facts.fact: Finance Minister Laaziz Faid told the National People's Assembly that the Treasury services' information system was adapted and put into service for expenditure execution under the programme budget from 1 January 2023.

Faid said the Djibayatic tax system covered 40 centres, with 43 tax centres, 37 proximity centres and the large-enterprise directorate digitised as of February 2024, and the Moussahamatic portal was extended to 242 tax offices in 31 wilaya directorates by end-2023.

note: No payroll system is named; the SIGB is said only to be in the course of publication.
